meta.bit_reading_note: counts are per task, keyed by the task's label; each task measures the pairs task_pairs names for it
meta.processor: Rigetti Cepheus-1-108Q, through Amazon Braket (us-west-1), pinned: named physical qubits in a verbatim box
meta.utc: 2026-10-06T15:17:27Z to 2026-10-06T15:34:50Z (creation of the first task to end of the last)
meta.times_note: creation and end of each task as Amazon Braket recorded them (createdAt, endedAt), to the second
meta.reading_rule: fixed before the run: c = r(X1, X4) < 0.7: NOT SETTLED (unstable); records present and not matching the names: MOVED; records matching (or absent) and d = r(mean X, Y and Y') >= 0.7: PINNED; records matching and d < 0.4: CROWDING; MIXED otherwise
meta.description: Stage 1, the placement check: four tasks of circuit A without the offset, X (all 27 pairs), Y (the pairs at odd positions), Y' (at even positions), X again, 8000 shots each, every program naming its physical qubits inside one verbatim box. The compiled program returned with each task is in compiled/k40/stage1/.

bit_order: each task's result carries measured_qubits; character j of a counts key belongs to measured_qubits[j]. A pair's two-outcome state is s = q0 + 2 q1, q0 being the pair's first qubit (the low bit), as in Kickoff 33
